thread:
mia_cs: FYI NorthBridge onboarding hit a wall on step 2 (warmup). Their CI runs ~150 headless browsers doing preflight; seeing spikes of 429s and occasional 401s. Renewal conversation next week, want this unblocked ASAP.

northbridge_se: Repro script: we spin 150 browsers in parallel, each hits /v1/preflight immediately after creating ephemeral token. Fail rate ~25% 429, ~2% 401. Token create calls look fast and succeed when retried.

arjun_sdk: Which SDK and version? Any custom auth plumbing?

northbridge_se: node-browser-sdk@0.19.0, we call /session/new per worker and attach token. No shared cache between workers since tests are isolated.

peng_eng: This smells like token creation + preflight burst hitting our preflight rate limiter. Two quick mitigations: 1) add a very short in-process token lease so concurrent workers reuse one token; 2) stagger test start by 50-300ms. Can you try a small change and rerun?

northbridge_se: Can paste headers. Sample response: "HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests\nRetry-After: 1\nX-Request-Id: nb-44a" and one 401: "HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized\nX-Request-Id: nb-44f"

deploy-bot: CONFIG: rate-limit update applied to preflight at 2026-03-19T17:30Z (rule: preflight-origin-3s).

arjun_sdk: That deploy looks relevant. Short-term patch snippet we recommend:```js// tiny in-memory lease (Node test runner)let lease=null;async function getLeaseToken(){if(lease && Date.now()<lease.exp) return lease.t;const t = await fetch('/session/new').then(r=>r.text());lease={t,exp:Date.now()+3000};return t;}```This reduces token-creation fanout across parallel runners.

mia_cs: I'll open a RevOps ticket to request a temporary quota bump for NorthBridge's onboarding run. Do we think 3s lease is sufficient?

peng_eng: 3s is a good low-friction start. Also advise them to add random jitter when starting each browser: setTimeout(startPreflight, Math.random()*300).

northbridge_se: Applied lease + jitter, re-ran 150 parallel. Failures dropped to ~6% 429 and no 401s. Good improvement.

arjun_sdk: If they still hit 429s at scale, longer-term SDK change: provide an optional "ephemeralLease" mode where the SDK coalesces session requests per origin for N ms. We'll draft that example.

mia_cs: Great. For the renewal risk: I'll mark onboarding behind schedule but mitigated. Keeping RevOps quota ticket open. NorthBridge wants a short doc snippet we can paste into their runbook.

northbridge_se: One other note: we saw one 401 when CI box clock was off by ~8s. We synced NTP and it disappeared. Heads-up for other customers using ephemeral tokens.

peng_eng: Good catch. Add NTP check to the onboarding checklist. Also we should consider a small backpressure queue in preflight service to accept short bursts and buffer for 200-500ms to smooth hot starts. Filing infra follow-up.

mia_cs: Thanks all. I'll send NorthBridge the quick runbook: how to enable lease + jitter, and ask RevOps to keep the temporary quota until full warmup completes. Will update thread when quota decision is in. :white_check_mark:
